raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes [#61027](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61027)

Serve MXFP4 and NVFP4 checkpoints on AMD Zen CPUs through zentorch's W4A8 kernel, for MoE experts and dense linear layers, with the weights kept at four bits. MoE experts go through `zentorch_fused_moe` and linear layers through `zentorch_dynamic_qlinear`, the ops the existing DA8W4 paths already use. Needs the next [zentorch](https://github.com/amd/ZenDNN-pytorch-plugin) release, which teaches both ops the E2M1 weight format; the `zen` extra pin moves to it before this merges.

## Claims

- **MXFP4 MoE on Zen** (`Mxfp4MoeBackend.ZEN_CPU`, preferred ahead of `CPU`): gpt-oss-20b runs +6.3% / +7.7% output tokens/s at batch size 32 and +1.8% / +2.8% at batch size 8, compared with vLLM's own MXFP4 MoE kernel. Upstream, that kernel (`CPUExpertsMxfp4`) needs AMX and the emulation experts need CUDA or XPU, so Zen CPUs currently have no MXFP4 MoE backend at all.
- **NVFP4 MoE on CPU** (`NvFp4MoeBackend.ZEN_CPU`): none existed. Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 now serves.
- **MXFP4 and NVFP4 linear on CPU** (`ZentorchMxFp4LinearKernel`, `ZentorchNvFp4LinearKernel`): the CPU had no kernel for either, so dense checkpoints failed kernel selection. NVFP4 covers W4A4 checkpoints; W4A16 NVFP4 linear is not served.
- **Selection off Zen is unchanged**: every new kernel gates on `has_zentorch_op`, which needs `ZenCpuPlatform`.

## Validation

```bash
export VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND=0-31 VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE=40
vllm bench throughput --model openai/gpt-oss-20b --dtype bfloat16 \
  --moe-backend zen_cpu --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 128 \
  --max-num-seqs 32 --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching

lm_eval --model vllm \
  --model_args "pretrained=openai/gpt-oss-20b,dtype=bfloat16,max_model_len=4096,kv_cache_dtype=fp8_e4m3,moe_backend=zen_cpu" \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size auto \
  --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=2048 --apply_chat_template
```

Turin (EPYC 9005), one 32-core NUMA node per run, with this PR and a zentorch build that carries the E2M1 support.

**Throughput**, gpt-oss-20b, output tokens/s, two interleaved reps per arm on one pod. Settings: random 1024 in / 1024 out, 128 prompts, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`, prefix caching off.

| Batch size | Native (`--moe-backend cpu`) | This PR (`zen_cpu`) | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32 | 191.3 / 189.5 | 203.4 / 204.2 | +6.3% / +7.7% |
| 8 | 84.0 / 84.3 | 85.4 / 86.7 | +1.8% / +2.8% |

The native arm needed a local one-line change, not part of this PR: `CPUExpertsMxfp4._supports_current_device` was relaxed from AMX to AVX-512 so the kernel could run on Zen at all. Each zen rep was checked against the native arm on the same prompts: the first generated token agrees on 119–120 of 128 prompts.

In a 128/128, batch-size-32 profile, MoE prompt time drops 31%. Decode is within 1.5% per call; that remainder is zentorch's per-call setup.

The other formats have no native CPU kernel to compare against. This PR's numbers, same settings, two reps:

| Model | Layers on zentorch | bs 32 | bs 8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 | MoE (NVFP4, group 16) | 103.4 / 104.6 | 54.6 / 54.4 |
| RedHatAI/Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4 | dense linear (MXFP4) | 56.3 / 56.3 | 30.3 / 30.4 |
| RedHatAI/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 | dense linear (NVFP4) | 42.2 / 41.3 | 21.3 / 21.8 |

**Accuracy**, GSM8K, full set, 5-shot, chat template, flexible-extract:

| Model | This PR | Native |
|---|---|---|
| openai/gpt-oss-20b | 0.872 | 0.868 |
| nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 | 0.857 | — |
| RedHatAI/Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4 | 0.973 | — |
| RedHatAI/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 | 0.713 | — |

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+### MXFP4 and NVFP4 checkpoints
+
+On `ZenCpuPlatform`, zentorch serves these with no extra flag:
+
+- MXFP4 MoE experts from `mxfp4` checkpoints such as `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, and MXFP4 dense linear layers.
+- NVFP4 (W4A4, from ModelOpt or llm-compressor) MoE experts and dense linear layers.
+
+Compressed-tensors and AutoRound MXFP4 MoE layers, and NVFP4 W4A16 linear layers, are not served by zentorch. The weights are never expanded or requantized: the checkpoint tensors and ZenDNN's packed copy of them both stay four-bit, and the W4A8 kernel quantizes activations to int8 per token on the fly. To confirm, look for `Using 'ZEN_CPU' Mxfp4 MoE backend`, `Using 'ZEN_CPU' NvFp4 MoE backend`, or `Using ZentorchMxFp4LinearKernel` / `Using ZentorchNvFp4LinearKernel` in the startup logs.
+
 ### Environment variables
 
 - `VLLM_ZENTORCH_WEIGHT_PREPACK` (default `1`): eagerly prepacks linear weights into ZenDNN's blocked layout at model load time, eliminating per-inference layout conversion overhead. Set to `0` to disable.

@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tests for the zentorch MXFP4 / NVFP4 linear kernels and scale conversion.
+
+The expected values come from vLLM's own E2M1 decode and NVFP4 dequant, so they
+check the scale convention zentorch's W4A8 kernel takes (E2M1 decoded at twice
+its value against halved scales). zentorch_dynamic_qlinear is mocked with that
+kernel's arithmetic when zentorch is not installed.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear import zentorch_utils
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp4.base import MxFp4LinearLayerConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp4.zentorch import (
+    ZentorchMxFp4LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.nvfp4.base import NvFp4LinearLayerConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.nvfp4.zentorch import (
+    ZentorchNvFp4LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.zentorch_utils import (
+    check_w4_group_shape,
+    w4_group_scale_from_e4m3,
+    w4_group_scale_from_e8m0,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle import mxfp4 as mxfp4_oracle
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle import nvfp4 as nvfp4_oracle
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.nvfp4_emulation_utils import (
+    break_fp4_bytes,
+    dequantize_to_dtype,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_cpu():
+    pytest.skip("skipping CPU-only tests", allow_module_level=True)
+
+N, K = 64, 256
+
+
+def _random_codes(*shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.randint(0, 256, (*shape, K // 2), dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _expand_groups(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """{..., G, N} group scales -> {..., N, K}."""
+    scale = scale.transpose(-1, -2)
+    return scale.repeat_interleave(K // scale.shape[-1], dim=-1)
+
+
+def _kernel_weight(codes: torch.Tensor, group_scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The W4A8 kernel's view of the weight: doubled E2M1 times its scales."""
+    doubled = break_fp4_bytes(codes.reshape(-1, K // 2), torch.float32) * 2
+    return doubled.reshape(*codes.shape[:-1], K) * _expand_groups(group_scale)
+
+
+def _per_token_int8_matmul(x, weight, bias):
+    # zentorch rounds activation ties away from zero; with E2M1 weights up to
+    # ~20, one int8 step on a tie is visible at the test tolerance.
+    x = x.double()
+    amax = x.abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True)
+    x_q = torch.trunc(x * (127 / amax) + 0.5 * x.sign())
+    out = ((x_q @ weight.double().t()) * (amax / 127)).float()
+    return out if bias is None else out + bias.float()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def mock_zentorch_ops(monkeypatch):
+    """Register a reference zentorch_dynamic_qlinear when zentorch is absent."""
+    for module in ("mxfp4", "nvfp4"):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            f"vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.{module}.zentorch.has_zentorch_op",
+            lambda ops: True,
+        )
+    if hasattr(torch.ops.zentorch, "zentorch_dynamic_qlinear"):
+        yield
+        return
+
+    def _dynamic_qlinear(
+        x,
+        weight,
+        weight_scales,
+        bias=None,
+        *,
+        is_weight_prepacked=False,
+        zentorch_op_name="",
+    ):
+        out = _per_token_int8_matmul(
+            x.reshape(-1, K), _kernel_weight(weight, weight_scales), bias
+        )
+        return out.to(x.dtype).reshape(*x.shape[:-1], weight.shape[0])
+
+    lib_def = torch.library.Library("zentorch", "DEF")
+    lib_def.define(
+        "zentorch_dynamic_qlinear(Tensor input, Tensor weight, "
+        "Tensor weight_scales, Tensor? bias=None, *, "
+        "bool is_weight_prepacked=False, "
+        "str zentorch_op_name='zentorch::zentorch_dynamic_qlinear') -> Tensor"
+    )
+    lib_impl = torch.library.Library("zentorch", "IMPL", "CPU")
+    lib_impl.impl("zentorch_dynamic_qlinear", _dynamic_qlinear)
+    yield
+    lib_impl._destroy()
+    lib_def._destroy()
+
+
+def _mxfp4_dequant(codes: torch.Tensor, e8m0: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    values = break_fp4_bytes(codes.reshape(-1, K // 2), torch.float32)
+    scale = torch.exp2(e8m0.float() - 127).reshape(-1, e8m0.shape[-1])
+    values = values * scale.repeat_interleave(32, dim=-1)
+    return values.reshape(*codes.shape[:-1], K)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("experts", [None, 3])
+def test_e8m0_group_scale_matches_mxfp4_dequant(experts):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    lead = () if experts is None else (experts,)
+    codes = _random_codes(*lead, N)
+    e8m0 = torch.randint(118, 136, (*lead, N, K // 32), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    group_scale = w4_group_scale_from_e8m0(e8m0)
+    assert group_scale.shape == (*lead, K // 32, N)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        _kernel_weight(codes, group_scale),
+        _mxfp4_dequant(codes, e8m0),
+        rtol=0,
+        atol=0,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("experts", [None, 3])
+def test_e4m3_group_scale_matches_nvfp4_dequant(experts):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    lead = () if experts is None else (experts,)
+    codes = _random_codes(*lead, N)
+    block = (torch.rand(*lead, N, K // 16) * 4 + 0.25).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    global_scale = torch.rand(experts or 1) + 0.5
+    expected = dequantize_to_dtype(
+        codes,
+        block,
+        global_scale if experts else global_scale[0],
+        torch.float32,
+        block_size=16,
+        swizzle=False,
+    )
+    group_scale = w4_group_scale_from_e4m3(block, global_scale)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(_kernel_weight(codes, group_scale), expected)
+
+
+def test_zen_cpu_moe_convert_emits_kernel_scales():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    E = 3
+    codes = _random_codes(E, N)
+    e8m0 = torch.randint(118, 136, (E, N, K // 32), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    _, _, w13_scale, _, _, _ = (
+        mxfp4_oracle.convert_gpt_oss_weight_to_mxfp4_moe_kernel_format(
+            mxfp4_backend=mxfp4_oracle.Mxfp4MoeBackend.ZEN_CPU,
+            layer=torch.nn.Module(),
+            w13_weight=codes,
+            w2_weight=codes,
+            w13_weight_scale=e8m0,
+            w2_weight_scale=e8m0,
+        )
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        _kernel_weight(codes, w13_scale), _mxfp4_dequant(codes, e8m0), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+    block = (torch.rand(E, N, K // 16) * 4 + 0.25).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    global_scale = torch.rand(E) + 0.5
+    _, w13_scale, *_ = nvfp4_oracle.convert_to_nvfp4_moe_kernel_format(
+        nvfp4_backend=nvfp4_oracle.NvFp4MoeBackend.ZEN_CPU,
+        layer=torch.nn.Module(),
+        w13=codes,
+        w13_scale=block,
+        w13_scale_2=global_scale,
+        a13_scale=None,
+        w2=codes,
+        w2_scale=block,
+        w2_scale_2=global_scale,
+        a2_scale=None,
+        is_act_and_mul=True,
+    )
+    expected = dequantize_to_dtype(
+        codes, block, global_scale, torch.float32, block_size=16, swizzle=False
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(_kernel_weight(codes, w13_scale), expected)
+
+
+def _make_layer(**params: torch.Tensor) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    for name, t in params.items():
+        setattr(layer, name, torch.nn.Parameter(t, requires_grad=False))
+    return layer
+
+
+def _process_keeping_params(kernel, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    params = dict(layer.named_parameters())
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    # Weight reloading writes through the loaded parameter objects.
+    assert all(getattr(layer, name) is p for name, p in params.items())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16])
+def test_mxfp4_linear_matches_dequantized_reference(mock_zentorch_ops, dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    codes = _random_codes(N)
+    e8m0 = torch.randint(120, 130, (N, K // 32), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    layer = _make_layer(weight=codes, weight_scale=e8m0)
+    kernel = ZentorchMxFp4LinearKernel(MxFp4LinearLayerConfig())
+    _process_keeping_params(kernel, layer)
+
+    x = torch.randn(5, K, dtype=dtype)
+    bias = torch.randn(N, dtype=dtype)
+    out = kernel.apply_weights(layer, x, bias)
+    assert out.dtype == dtype
+    # The kernel computes from bf16, whatever the model's dtype.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MXFP4 linear backed by zentorch's W4A8 custom kernel on AMD Zen CPUs.
+
+The CPU had no MXFP4 linear kernel at all, so a dense MXFP4 checkpoint used to
+fail kernel selection outright; only the MoE experts path was served.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.zentorch_utils import (
+    check_w4_group_shape,
+    has_zentorch_op,
+    w4_group_linear,
+    w4_group_scale_from_e8m0,
+    warn_if_zentorch_predates_e2m1,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import kMxfp4Dynamic
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import replace_parameter
+
+from .base import MxFp4LinearKernel, MxFp4LinearLayerConfig
+
+
+class ZentorchMxFp4LinearKernel(MxFp4LinearKernel):
+    """MXFP4 linear served by zentorch's W4A8 kernel, weights left four-bit.
+
+    Shares everything but the scale conversion with the NVFP4 kernel: E2M1
+    codes go through packed, and only the E8M0 exponents are folded into the
+    per-group floats the kernel takes.
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(
+        cls, compute_capability: int | None = None
+    ) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if not has_zentorch_op(["zentorch_dynamic_qlinear"]):
+            return False, "requires a Zen CPU with zentorch loaded"
+        return True, None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(cls, config: MxFp4LinearLayerConfig) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        # The kernel quantizes bf16 activations to int8 itself, so a W4A4
+        # checkpoint's activation scales go unused rather than unsupported.
+        if config.activation_quant_key not in (None, kMxfp4Dynamic):
+            return False, "only MXFP4 or unquantized activations"
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        warn_if_zentorch_predates_e2m1()
+        e8m0 = layer.weight_scale.data
+        n, packed_k = layer.weight.shape
+        check_w4_group_shape(n, packed_k * 2, e8m0.shape[-1])
+
+        replace_parameter(layer, "weight_scale", w4_group_scale_from_e8m0(e8m0))
+
+    def apply_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return w4_group_linear(layer.weight, layer.weight_scale, x, bias)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""NVFP4 linear backed by zentorch's W4A8 custom kernel on AMD Zen CPUs."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.zentorch_utils import (
+    check_w4_group_shape,
+    has_zentorch_op,
+    w4_group_linear,
+    w4_group_scale_from_e4m3,
+    warn_if_zentorch_predates_e2m1,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import replace_parameter
+
+from .base import NvFp4LinearKernel, NvFp4LinearLayerConfig
+
+
+class ZentorchNvFp4LinearKernel(NvFp4LinearKernel):
+    """NVFP4 linear served by zentorch's W4A8 kernel, weights left four-bit.
+
+    Only the two scale levels are folded into the per-group floats the kernel
+    takes; the E2M1 codes are passed through packed and are never requantized
+    or expanded.
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(
+        cls, compute_capability: int | None = None
+    ) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if not has_zentorch_op(["zentorch_dynamic_qlinear"]):
+            return False, "requires a Zen CPU with zentorch loaded"
+        return True, None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(cls, config: NvFp4LinearLayerConfig) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        # NvFp4LinearLayerConfig carries no shape, so the gates are checked
+        # against the real weights in process_weights_after_loading.
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        warn_if_zentorch_predates_e2m1()
+        block_scale = layer.weight_scale.data
+        n, packed_k = layer.weight.shape
+        check_w4_group_shape(n, packed_k * 2, block_scale.shape[-1])
+
+        replace_parameter(
+            layer,
+            "weight_scale",
+            w4_group_scale_from_e4m3(block_scale, layer.weight_global_scale.data),
+        )
+
+    def apply_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return w4_group_linear(layer.weight, layer.weight_scale, x, bias)

+def w4_group_scale_from_e8m0(e8m0: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """MXFP4's E8M0 block exponents as the kernel's {..., G, N} float scales.
+
+    Halved because the kernel decodes E2M1 at twice the true magnitude, which
+    is what makes every level an exact integer.
+    """
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.fp8_utils import (
+        _upcast_e8m0_to_fp32,
+    )
+
+    return (_upcast_e8m0_to_fp32(e8m0) * 0.5).transpose(-1, -2).contiguous()
+
+
+def w4_group_scale_from_e4m3(
+    block_scale: torch.Tensor, global_scale: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """NVFP4's E4M3 block scales times the per-tensor global, as {..., G, N}.
+
+    Halved for the same doubled-E2M1 reason as the E8M0 path. Both checkpoint
+    formats normalize the global to the dequant multiplier before this point.
+    """
+    scale = block_scale.to(torch.float32)
+    g = global_scale.to(torch.float32).reshape(-1)
+    # Per-expert for a 3D MoE scale, a single value for a 2D linear one.
+    g = g.view(-1, 1, 1) if scale.ndim == 3 else g.view(1, 1)
+    return (scale * g * 0.5).transpose(-1, -2).contiguous()
+
+
+def check_w4_group_shape(n: int, k: int, groups: int) -> int:
+    """Validate a four-bit linear against the kernel's gates, returning group_size."""
+    if k % groups:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"zentorch four-bit linear: K ({k}) must be divisible by the "
+            f"group count ({groups})"
+        )
+    group_size = k // groups
+    if group_size % _W4_K_OCTET or n % _W4_MIN_PACK_NR:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"zentorch four-bit linear: group_size ({group_size}) must be a "
+            f"multiple of {_W4_K_OCTET} and N ({n}) a multiple of "
+            f"{_W4_MIN_PACK_NR}"
+        )
+    return group_size
+

+    if Version(installed) < Version(_ZENTORCH_E2M1_MIN_VERSION):

+            "(needs >= %s, the version vllm[zen] installs): MXFP4 and NVFP4 "
+            "linear layers will produce wrong output. Reinstall with vllm[zen].",
+            installed,
+            _ZENTORCH_E2M1_MIN_VERSION,
+        )
+
+
+def w4_group_linear(
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    group_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run an E2M1 linear through zentorch's dynamic-quant (DA8W4) linear."""
+    # The kernel takes only bf16, and the layer config carries no activation
+    # dtype to gate on, so an fp16 or f32 model is served through a cast.
+    if bias is not None:

+    out = torch.ops.zentorch.zentorch_dynamic_qlinear.default(
+        x.to(torch.bfloat16), weight, group_scale, bias
+    )
+    return out.to(x.dtype)
